title: Coverage Bulletin: First Covered Day of a Customer-Arranged Rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Coverage position.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the first covered day of a customer-arranged rental depends on the loss and on the repair path. It is determined from the claim report and the estimate entries on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim, and from the closings on the claim's rental ledger.

1. **Total theft.** Where the cause of loss on the claim report is a total theft, the first covered day is the later of two days:
   - the rental's start date; and
   - the day that falls the option's theft waiting days, in calendar days, after the claim's report date. That is 1 day after on 30/900, 40/1200 and 50/1500, and 0 days after on 60/1800, 75/2250 and 100/3000.
2. **Supplemental repair.** Where the cause of loss is anything other than a total theft, the first covered day is the date of the supplement estimate if all three of the following hold:
   - the claim carries a rental closed because repairs were complete;
   - the latest estimate on the claim is a supplement (estimate sequence 1 or higher);
   - that latest estimate is dated later than the customer-arranged rental's start date.
   That date is the day the shop records the vehicle back for the supplemental repair.
3. **Otherwise,** the first covered day is the rental's start date.

The covered days of a customer-arranged rental are counted from its first covered day through its last covered day, both included, and are never fewer than zero.

## Cases (hypothetical dates, customer-arranged rental starting April 10)

| Situation on the claim | First covered day |
|---|---|
| Total theft reported April 12, option 40/1200 | April 13 |
| Total theft reported April 2, option 40/1200 | April 10 (the start date is later than April 3) |
| Total theft reported April 12, option 100/3000 | April 12 |
| Collision; a rental closed on repairs complete; latest estimate is sequence 1, written April 14 | April 14 |
| Collision; a rental closed on repairs complete; latest estimate is sequence 1, written April 8 | April 10 |
| Collision; no rental closed on repairs complete | April 10 |
